nodes.text: Mayday... is anyone out there? Our reactor is dead. We need 50 Energy Cores or we're going to freeze.

options.text: We can spare the cores. (Give 50 Energy Cores)

nodes.text: We're an independent surveying crew. Please, the temperature is dropping rapidly.

options.text: Sorry, we need them for our own survival. (Leave)

nodes.text: Thank you! You saved our lives. Here, we found these coordinates before our ship died. It's an untouched Ancient Tech cache.

options.text: Upload coordinates to the ship's nav-computer. (End)
